name: The Notting Hill Bookshop
description: The real Blenheim Crescent travel bookshop that inspired Richard Curtis's film. It closed in 2011 after the movie's success pushed up rents, then reopened here as The Notting Hill Bookshop.
highlight: The real-life bookshop that inspired 'Notting Hill'
address: 13 Blenheim Crescent, London W11 2EE, United Kingdom
